metadata.document_title: The Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017

article.title: Power to make regulations.
article.content:
165Power to make regulations.

Section 165  ·  Chapter XXI  ·  page 121 of the Act
The Board may, by notification, make regulations consistent with this Act and the rules made thereunder to carry out the provisions of this Act.
